question: Oxolane is a synonym of which compound having the molecular formula (CH₂)₃CH₂O?
solution:
The correct answer is__** tetrahydrofuran.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **tetrahydrofuran:-**

 
 
• Oxolane is a cyclic ether with the molecular formula C₄H₈O.
 
• It is also known as tetrahydrofuran (THF).
 
• THF is a colorless, water-miscible organic liquid with a faintly sweet odor. It is widely used as a solvent in chemical reactions and as a starting material for the synthesis of various organic compounds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thiophene:-**

 
 
• It is a heterocyclic compound with the molecular formula C₄H₄S.
 
• It is a colorless to pale yellow liquid with a strong odor. Thiophene and its derivatives are used in the production of various organic compounds, including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and polymers. 
 
 
 
• **Tetrahedrane**:-
 
 
• It is a hypothetical compound with a tetrahedral arrangement of four carbon atoms. It is a highly strained molecule that has not been synthesized yet.
 
• Tetrahedrane and its derivatives are studied for their potential applications in materials science and catalysis.
 
 
 
• **Tropolone**:-
 
 
• It is an aromatic compound with the molecular formula C7H6O2. It is a yellow crystalline solid with a bitter taste. Tropolone and its derivatives are used as chelating agents, antioxidants, and antibacterial agents.
